notes: «وَ ذُكِرَ اَلنِّسَاءُ عِنْدَ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ ... فَقَالَ» names no transmitter: the Imam is the speaker, so he is the only link (rule 10); «عند» is the place and is not a second link.
